name: research-token-guard
description: Capture bounded, hash-verifiable receipts for predictably large command output while preserving exact raw streams on disk.

interface.shortDescription: Bound large command output with exact receipts.
interface.longDescription: Provides exact stdout and stderr receipts, bounded evidence retrieval, an append-only stage ledger, and controlled provider-usage evaluation for commands whose output would otherwise be large or repeatedly reread. It is not a universal shell wrapper.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Research Token Guard for this predictably noisy command and preserve exact evidence.
